en: The front of the postcard shows a young woman in a striped red shirt and hat, smiling while sitting on a railing overlooking a wide sandy beach, hotel buildings, and a promenade along a blue sea. In the background, green hills rise above the coast. Prominent Cyrillic text appears at the bottom. The reverse side has multilingual text indicating the location, a library stamp, handwritten numbers, and a printed value of 10 stotinki.
